marta_marketing: Heads up — seeing a batch of EMEA leads stuck in "Unassigned" despite HubSpot owner rules. Anyone else? :eyes:
jordan_sales_ops: Yea noticed ~20 from this morning's webinar. HubSpot shows owner set, but SFDC owner is null.kevin_revops: Sync logs show 409 conflict on assignment for those leads. Probably timezone window causing overlap during cutover.anya_engineering: Can you paste sample lead IDs? I'll check the sync job and timezone normalization.marta_marketing: 0051ab, 0051ac — both have hs_createdate 2026-10-12T23:50:00Z. HubSpot owner workflow triggers with "Create date between X and Y (UTC)".jordan_sales_ops: Our SLA calc in dashboard uses local day boundaries (PST) — that's why they look unassigned for >4h SLA.kevin_revops: Proposed fix:
- Make HubSpot workflow owner assignment based on "Original source + Country" fallback
- Add round-robin fallback owner pool 'EMEA-Overflow'
- Update SLA metric to use UTC created_atanya_engineering: I can patch the sync service to normalize timestamps and add a heuristic:
```
if hs_owner is None:
  assign_pool('emea-overflow')
else:
  push_to_sfdc(hs_owner)
```
kevin_revops: Also suggest adding a retry on 409 with backoff — we saw SF duplicate owner write race.marta_marketing: Could we also enrich leads with ip->timezone to prefer local reps? Some lead intel misses country field.jordan_sales_ops: Good ask. For enrichment, we should call the enrichment service during workflow. But keep it async so SLA not blocked.kevin_revops: Action items:
- @anya to deploy timestamp-normalization and 409 retry (ETA today EOD)
- @jordan_sales_ops to create 'EMEA-Overflow' queue in Salesforce (ETA tomorrow AM)
- @marta_marketing to add test lead flows and confirm (ETA tomorrow noon)
- @devops-bot Please run a canary of sync after deploydevops-bot: deploy started for branch fix/hs-sf-tz-fix — job 4823. Logs: https://ci/internal/4823anya_engineering: Deployed, canary passed on 10 sample leads. Observability shows SLA metric already switching to UTC baseline.jordan_sales_ops: Created queue + round robin rule. Verified one of the stuck leads moved into EMEA-Overflow.marta_marketing: Amazing — thanks team :tada:kevin_revops: We'll monitor 24h. If still spikes, next step is to add pre-sync enrichment call to patch missing country.marta_marketing: Noted. I'll update the playbook and add a blurb for SDRs about timezone handoffs.jordan_sales_ops: FYI adding a quick dashboard note: "SLA calc timezone: UTC from 2026-10-13" so everyone sees change.marta_marketing: Closing the loop — will post a short launch note in #marketing and notify support.
